### DICE

Digital Twin-Driven In-Field Continuous-Test Engine for Silicon Lifecycle Management. DICE connects runtime telemetry, operational context, and digital-twin reasoning for in-field test and lifecycle assurance. In current experiments, it achieves 75% anomaly detection with zero false alarms using a compact profile and 95% detection with zero false alarms using richer telemetry.
:::

::: {.project-card}
![](assets/img/architecture.png){fig-alt="EXACT project architecture"}

### EXACT

Edge-eXplainable Autonomous Causal Telemetry for Silicon Lifecycle Management. EXACT targets explainable, causal, and deployment-aware telemetry analytics for dependable systems using a 15-feature budget, fixed-point anomaly scoring, less than 0.005% CPU die-area overhead, and 3.4 pJ/sample evaluation cost.
:::

::: {.project-card}
![](assets/img/x-octane.jpg){fig-alt="X-OCTANE project figure"}

### X-OCTANE

eXplainable On-Chip Telemetry-based Anomaly Notification Engine for Silicon Lifecycle Management, focused on practical anomaly notification and explainability from chip telemetry. Current results report less than 0.75% CPU die-area overhead, less than 1% non-idle power overhead, and more than 20% improvement in anomaly diagnosis accuracy.
:::

::: {.project-card}
![](assets/img/track-exchange.png){fig-alt="TRACK project figure"}

### TRACK

Telemetry-based Representation Analysis via Centered Kernel Alignment for Silicon Lifecycle Management, focused on comparing telemetry representations and tracking signal structure.
:::
:::

## Semiconductor Facility Intelligence

Before my current postdoctoral focus on chip and system lifecycle assurance, my doctoral work studied AI-driven optimization for semiconductor manufacturing facilities. This includes HVAC/MEP optimization, energy efficiency modeling, indoor air quality, reliability, supply-chain resilience, and circularity for high-reliability fab environments.
